name: footnotes
description: Footnotes: adaptive music that helps people with Parkinson's walk more steadily. DurHack 2026.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @footnotes/server" "npm run dev -w @footnotes/web"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @footnotes/server" "npm run dev:https -w @footnotes/web"
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run start
